The Company has received notice from Sale tax Officer Class II/AVATO , Delhi on account of non reversal of Input tax credit as per rule 42/43 of CGST rule, 2017 and Supplier filed GSTR-3B with Nil turnover and did not declare or pay tax corresponding to the invoices declared in GSTR-01. The Company has filed reply alongwith supporting documents that the mentioned these rule is not applicable on us due to banking industry including NBFC. The Adjudicating authority has not consider the reply and issued final order for demand. The Appeal has been filed against this order.
